Case_22008/figure1.jpg.source_caption: Physical exam finding. Dense, erythematous, maculopapular eruption

description.short_caption: Erythematous maculopapular eruption on the skin.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a section of skin with a dense, erythematous maculopapular eruption. The lesions are small, red, and slightly raised, distributed across the visible area. Sparse hair is present, and the background skin appears slightly inflamed. The pattern suggests a diffuse involvement, consistent with a systemic or localized dermatologic process.

Case_22008/figure3.jpg.source_caption: Physical exam finding. Morbilliform eruption along back and flanks

description.short_caption: Morbilliform eruption on the back and flanks.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a widespread morbilliform eruption characterized by erythematous macules and papules distributed across the back and flanks. The lesions are confluent in some areas, creating a diffuse erythematous appearance. The surrounding skin appears otherwise intact, and no vesicles, pustules, or ulcerations are visible. The image is taken in a clinical setting, with part of a hospital bed visible in the background.
